name: Majo Gari no Yoru ni
source:
Europe of the Middle Ages, where hunting witchs by church was universal. Rudo, the main character of this game, is the Father of a church but doesn't believe in God. He uses his standing just to deceive and rape women. The game starts from his transferring to a small church which is located on a rural village and isn't controled by central church. In the church just two nuns work. A young monk follows and helps him even to the H scenes.

From that day on he wanders around in and out of village to meet up many women. And story goes on simply. He maneuvers people into believing that a woman is a witch by using some drug or demon sculpture to a woman. Then he punishes the woman in H way in the basement of the church to test whether she is a witch or not. The basement is equipped with many SM tools such as ropes, chains, and a wooden horse on which iron blade is added. One day he detects two nuns playing les love which is prohibited to them, so he punishes each girl with H actions also.

Other day in the forest near the village he finds a villager, Nak, having sex with a 'real' witch. Nak becomes crippled after it and Rudo will penalize him for having relations with a witch, so Serena, Nak's wife, saves him by using her body. At last, one night Rudo faces the real witch in the forest. Is he doomed to die after H with her?

(from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=273&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url])
translation:
故事發生在教會獵巫之風盛行的中世紀歐洲。主角Rudo是一名神父，卻並不信仰上帝，只利用自己的身分欺騙並強暴女性。遊戲從他被調往一座鄉村小教堂開始，那裡不受中央教會管轄，教堂裡只有兩名修女。一名年輕修士跟隨並協助他，甚至參與H場景。

從那天起，他在村內外四處遊蕩，接觸許多女性，故事也簡單地延續下去。他會使用藥物或惡魔雕像，操縱人們相信某個女人是女巫，隨後在教堂地下室以性行為「懲罰」她，檢驗她是否真是女巫。地下室配備了繩索、鎖鏈和加裝鐵刃的木馬等多種SM器具。一天，他發現兩名修女有著受教會禁止的同性情慾關係，於是也分別用性行為懲罰她們。

另一天，他在村莊附近森林中發現村民Nak與一個「真正的」女巫發生關係。Nak事後落得殘疾，Rudo準備懲罰他與女巫來往，Nak的妻子Serena便用自己的身體救他。最終某個夜晚，Rudo在森林中直面真正的女巫。與她發生性關係後，他是否註定會死？

（摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=273&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]）
